closed.title: Evotel outage | Witbank
closed.description: Evotel has informed us of a network outage affecting Witbank, affected clients will experience limited to no connectivity. Evotel engineers are working on resolving this issue as soon as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused

updates.content:
Cause of the outage is due to a cable break. Evotel's technical team remains onsite continuing with network testing and investigations to address the remaining connectivity issues in Witbank.

However, a power disruption in the area is currently affecting the team's ability to fully verify the status of the remaining connections. Despite this, technicians are conducting external network tests to identify and address any outstanding faults.

Once power has been restored, the team will conduct further checks to confirm the number of affected clients and determine whether any additional restoration work is required.
